rules._comment: Level-2 copy of the C++ Noth strategy (off-tank gathers the Plagued adds onto the tank for the raid to cleave). No new shapes, no build: the action 'tank_adds' already self-detects the adds from the group 'attackers' list, self-gates to assist-tank #0, and does attack -> taunt -> reposition. We just need a trigger that fires in BOTH phases -- the existing generic 'has attackers' trigger (attacker count >= 1) does, including the balcony phase where Noth is non-attackable / off-threat and a 'find target noth' gate would go silent. tank_adds matches ONE name, and Noth has three add types, so list all three actions under one rule; they fall through (whichever add type is up acts this tick). Drags to the main tank's live position; for a fixed center cleave point (2684.94,-3502.53,261.31) tank_adds would need an optional x/y/z param (small C++ add). See BossNotes/Noth.md.
